question: Sex ratio in India is defined as the number of females per __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1000 males in the population**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sex ratio** in India (and most other places) is typically defined as the number of females per **1000 males in the population**.
 
• It's a demographic measure used to indicate the proportion of** males to females in a population**.
 
• A higher sex ratio implies a larger number of females compared to males, and a lower sex ratio implies a larger number of males compared to females.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• By the **2011 census**, there were **46 'million-plus cities' in India**, with **Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata having populations over 10 million.**
 
• There are 53 urban agglomerations in India with a population of 1 million or more by the 2011 census.
 
• **According to the 2001 census**, there were **35 cities in India** that have more than **1 million population**.
 
• 31.165 % population can be categorized under Urban as per the **2011 Census.**
 
• By census 2011, Goa is the most urbanized state with 62.17% of the population living in urban areas.
